hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *love_backend/*.py) out=$(python3 -m py_compile "$f" 2>&1) || jq -n --arg c "Syntax error in $f" --arg o "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:($c+"\n"+$o)}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
